requiredGates.description: Confirmed legal entity/provider and applicable authority
Authority/attestation/license/other legal basis verified and in force where required
Current legal act(s) and effective edition verified
Approved training program with version and approver
Exact completion document type and issuer resolved
Knowledge-check/exam rules, commission and threshold resolved
Rights for all learner/public materials confirmed

transitionPolicy: If sources conflict on effective date or status, publication gate `regulation` fails until the formal amending act is verified.
historyPolicy: Never rewrite historical learner documents when regulation changes; create a new course/program/test/consent version.
